study type: Observational study, cross-sectional and longitudinal analysis
exposure: Type of maternity care (public, semiprivate, private)
Women who changed from public to private care for their second pregnancy
cohort: 73,266 women with singleton pregnancies and 1830 women with multiple pregnancies who delivered between 2009 and 2017 at a large European maternity hospital
finding: Women who chose private maternity care had a higher rate of CS compared to those who chose publicly-funded care, primarily due to an increase in elective CS, which decreased after adjusting for clinical risks.
mod_finding: Women who changed from public to private care for their second pregnancy were more likely to have had a previous emergency CS.
